classification_definitions.exact_case_reuse: Established assigned fixture/model/premise equivalence, with route authority limit retained; does not imply current execution or universal campaign coverage.
classification_definitions.related_rule_control: Actual case inputs and dispatch test a related boundary; a different model, premise, claim kind, operation or consumer prevents literal reuse.
classification_definitions.retained_diagnostic_observation: Existing bounded evidence or historical observation retained as such; not minted mathematical authority.
classification_definitions.historical_defect_not_reproduced: Source records a specific defect; the selected existing cases do not reproduce that exact implementation/lifecycle behavior.
classification_definitions.design_backlog: Missing semantic contract, positive capability or presentation requirement; no implemented checker or newly admitted incident inferred.

stop_condition.parent_follow_up: Independent review, mathematical admission and final coverage remain with coordinator. Extraction gaps below are specific future candidates, not instructions to execute.

evidence_limits: Only existing Phase 0a reports, four existing Phase 0b source reports, targeted case payloads and ROUTES were read. No campaign files or fixture content newly read.

All historical versions, fixes and campaign outcomes remain attributed to the bounded reports. No oracle/test/CAS/Lean/campaign execution, source inspection, harvesting, copying, installs, commits, external reads or delegation occurred.
Related controls cannot supply a missing campaign model or premise. Conditional-rule routes assume premises; descriptive registry coverage does not provide a checker.
The two exact reuse dispositions are DK-GP04/X399 and DK-GP06/X400. X401 is a declaration-with-debt contrast, X402/X403 are missing E5 bridge controls; none licenses a proved family conclusion.

No cost, shipping, core expressibility or current catch conclusion is synthesized. Wrong published or relied-on handoff remains unestablished; source encoding effort in DK-GP05 is preserved in its finding.
No report row is automatically a mathematical incident; hostile probes, blocked tools, legitimate derived identities and presentation observations retain their distinct categories.
